verdict.rationale: Companies House's own pages show core filing transactions done online: filing abridged or full accounts, changing a registered office address, and filing "certain documents online instead of posting a paper form," with identity verification also offered as an online service. The "certain documents" wording implies not every filing is online. missing for 10: explicit evidence that company incorporation/registration itself can be completed online, confirmation of which filings remain paper-only, online fee payment, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end filing.
